Technical trend is still corrective: price is below key short- and medium-term averages, MACD is negative, and a close below 338.57 then the 200-SMA near 334.29 could open further downside.

Regulatory, litigation, AI-competition and capital-allocation risks remain material and are not fully quantified in the supplied data.
